description: Puts an event on the calendar of address `id`. `start` and `end` are local wall times with no zone — `2026-11-03T14:00:00` — read in `timezone`, or the calendar’s default without one. For an all-day event `end` is the last day, inclusive. `recurrence.rule` is an RRULE such as `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU`. **Attendees are not told unless `send_invites` is true**, and then every attendee is emailed an invitation — that is mail to people outside the account, so only do it when you were asked to invite them. When retrying, reuse its `idempotency_key`.

idempotency_key.description: Any string unique to this send. Reuse the same key when retrying the same send, and it goes out once. Without one, an identical call within the hour counts as a retry.

name: create_calendar_event
title: Put something on the calendar
